Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with compalints of neck
and low back pain. The reported injury pattern is consistent with the mechanism and
force of the impact. Over the course of 14 visits, care consisted of conservative
management including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed
analgesia, and it followed a typical clinical progression with symptoms tapering as
range of motion and function improved. Examination documented paraspinal muscle
tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, supporting a soft tissue strain;
however, neurological screening, reflexes, and straight leg raise testing were within
normal limits. Review of the record also shows the patient was treated for the same
body region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute
to some of the current symptoms. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or
repeated charges for services. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise and
return to activity as tolerated.
</page>

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
